title: Comparables XAI: Faithful Example-based AI Explanations with Counterfactual Trace Adjustments
abstract: arXiv:2602.13784v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Explaining with examples is an intuitive way to justify AI decisions. However, it is challenging to understand how a decision value should change relative to the examples with many features differing by large amounts. We draw from real estate valuation that uses Comparables-examples with known values for comparison. Estimates are made more accurate by hypothetically adjusting the attributes of each Comparable and correspondingly changing the value based on factors. We propose Comparables XAI for relatable example-based explanations of AI with Trace adjustments that trace counterfactual changes from each Comparable to the Subject, one attribute at a time, monotonically along the AI feature space. In modelling and user studies, Trace-adjusted Comparables achieved the highest XAI faithfulness and precision, user accuracy, and narrowest uncertainty bounds compared to linear regression, linearly adjusted Comparables, or unadjusted C

translated_title: 可比案例XAI：基于反事实轨迹调整实现忠实的示例化AI解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.13784v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：用示例来解释AI决策是一种直观的论证方式。然而，当示例与目标对象在许多特征上存在较大差异时，理解决策值应如何相对于示例发生改变是一项挑战。我们借鉴了房地产估价中使用“可比案例”（Comparables）的做法，即采用具有已知价值的示例进行比较，通过假设性地调整每个可比案例的属性，并基于相关因素相应地改变其价值，从而提高估值的准确性。我们提出Comparables XAI，通过“轨迹调整”提供易于关联的基于示例的AI解释：轨迹调整从每个可比案例出发，沿AI特征空间逐个属性、单调地追踪到目标对象的反事实变化。在建模实验和用户研究中，与线性回归、线性调整的可比案例或未调整的可比案例相比，经过轨迹调整的可比案例实现了最高的XAI忠实度与精确度、最高的用户决策准确度以及最窄的不确定性界限。
tldr: 该论文借鉴房地产估价中的可比案例调整方法，提出Comparables XAI框架，通过沿特征空间逐属性单调追踪反事实变化的轨迹调整机制，使基于示例的AI解释在忠实度、精确度和用户决策准确度上显著优于线性回归及传统调整方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Comparables XAI, which adapts real-estate valuation's comparable-adjustment approach to example-based AI explanations by tracing counterfactual, attribute-by-attribute changes along the feature space, achieving the highest explanation faithfulness, precision, and user accuracy compared to linear regression and conventional adjustment baselines.
